name: anubis-guardian
description: Deterministic security auditor for AI-built projects — Codebase Mode + URL Mode (offline-first, MIT).

scripts.honeypot:verify: node tests/honeypot/setup.mjs && node dist/cli.js scan tests/honeypot/app tests/honeypot/nest-app --format json --output tests/honeypot/findings.json && node tests/verify-honeypot.mjs
scripts.clean:verify: node tests/clean/setup.mjs && node dist/cli.js scan tests/clean/app --format json --output tests/clean/findings.json && node tests/verify-clean.mjs
scripts.capab:verify: node tests/capab/setup.mjs && node dist/cli.js scan tests/capab/app --format json --output tests/capab/findings.json && node tests/capab/verify-capab.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run units:verify && npm run reachability:verify && npm run honeypot:verify && npm run clean:verify && npm run capab:verify && npm run regression:phase1 && npm run regression:phase2 && npm run sarif:verify && npm run acceptance:v02 && npm run acceptance:v03 && npm run mode2:verify && npm run acceptance:v04 && npm run acceptance:v10
scripts.sarif:verify: node dist/cli.js scan tests/honeypot/app --format sarif --output tests/.tmp/anubis-test.sarif && node tests/verify-sarif.mjs tests/.tmp/anubis-test.sarif
